description: Maps a detected stack to a recommended ShipWithAI stack plugin. init surfaces the recommendation (Part 6.6) and, if the plugin is enabled, invokes its setupCommand (Step 5). starter knows WHEN; the stack plugin knows WHAT.

recipes.reason: Just-in-time guardrails for the mistakes JPA dev forgets — missing @Version, non-public @Transactional, entity-in-controller leaks, N+1, query injection — plus correct-by-default entity/endpoint/migration scaffolds.
